title: Anchored Receipt Family Schema
description: Declarative manifest for an Anchored Receipts family member. Feeds defineFamily() and validates against FAMILY-CONSISTENCY.md invariants.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this meta-schema for editor support.

id.description: Primary wire discriminator, e.g. ar.consent.v1. Must match one of claim_types.

acronym.description: Three-to-five-letter family acronym, e.g. APR, ACR, ATokR.

name.description: Full family name, e.g. Anchored Consent Receipts.

claim_types.description: Owned claim_type discriminators. Most families own 1; ARR closure set owns 6.

envelope.description: Target envelope version. v2 is default for all families authored post-v1.1.

sign.description: Signature algorithm. Only ed25519 is supported in v1.

canonicalize.description: Canonicalization scheme. Only RFC 8785 JCS is supported.

chip.description: verify.dekimu.com/check chip position per FAMILY-CONSISTENCY section 1.

status_list_slot.description: W3C Bitstring Status List 2021 consumer ordering. null = non-revocable (e.g. APR).

subject_presence.description: Envelope subject field presence rule per FAMILY-CONSISTENCY section 3.

subject_presence_overrides.description: Per-event overrides when subject_presence is 'either' or varies by event_type.

tsa_upgrade_path.description: How the family acquires RFC 3161 TSA tokens.

tsa_mandate.description: Per-event TSA mandate level. Keys = event_type or profile ID or '*'. Values = level.

body.description: Body field declarations. Keys are field names; values are type descriptors.

event_types.description: Wire-level event_type discriminators within the family.

continuity.description: Whether this family supports envelope continuity attestations.

status_list.description: Whether this family consumes W3C Bitstring Status List 2021.

suspension.description: Whether this family supports the suspensionStatus two-way list.

spec_path.description: URL (or repository-relative path) of the family's design spec.

packages.description: Published package names and versions for this family.

type.description: Field type. sha256 = 'sha256:<hex>' commit. iso8601 = RFC 3339 timestamp.

required.description: Whether the field is mandatory in the body.

nullable.description: Whether the field may be null.

enum_values.description: Closed set of allowed values when type is 'enum'.

regulation.description: Regulation reference, e.g. GDPR Art. 7, NIS2 Art. 23.

tsa_override.description: If this profile overrides the default TSA mandate level.

extra_fields.description: Additional body fields required when this profile is active.

walk_parents.description: Whether this family performs parent-graph walks (e.g. ALR).

links_to.description: Other families this family composes with.

chain_predecessor.description: Whether this family uses prev-chain linkage.

event_type.description: The event_type this override applies to.
